description: Submit developer feedback on a previously returned WCAG fix/artifact, keyed by its finding_id. Records a rating plus an optional reason_code and the code the developer actually shipped, so the fix pipeline can learn from misses. Requires ALLCHEMY_API_KEY.

developerCorrection.description: The code the developer actually shipped (becomes raw material for a new template)

findingId.description: The finding_id of the artifact the rating targets (from a scan/fix result)

reasonCode.description: Why the fix missed: wrong_fix | didnt_apply | broke_something | unclear | wrong_technique | other

scanId.description: The scan_id the finding belonged to

versions.description: Version stamps echoed from the artifact for attribution

name: aether_submit_feedback
